units.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
units.text: 4. Liability for failure to observe the prohibitions provided for by this Article is established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 1) perform official duties conscientiously and to a high professional standard;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 2) proceed from the principle that recognition, observance and protection of human and civil rights and freedoms determine the meaning and content of their professional service activity;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 3) carry out professional service activities within the competence of the state body established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 4) ensure equal and impartial treatment of all individuals and legal entities, give no preference to any public or religious association, professional or social group, citizen or organization, and avoid bias towards such associations, groups, citizens and organizations;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 5) refrain from actions influenced by any personal, property-related (financial) or other interests that obstruct conscientious performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 6) observe the restrictions established by federal laws for civil servants;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 7) maintain neutrality, excluding the possibility that decisions of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations influence their professional service activity;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 8) refrain from acts disgracing their honour and dignity;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 9) be courteous in dealings with citizens;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 10) respect the moral customs and traditions of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 11) take account of the cultural and other characteristics of different ethnic and social groups and religious denominations;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 12) promote interethnic and interfaith concord;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 13) avoid conflict situations capable of damaging their reputation or the state body's authority;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 14) observe the established rules for public speaking and provision of official information.
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category must prevent civil servants from being compelled to participate in the activities of political parties, other public associations or religious associations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 1. For the purposes of this Law, the concepts of ‘conflict of interest’ and ‘personal interest’ established by Article 10 of the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’ are used.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 2. The emergence of personal interests of civil servants that give rise or may give rise to a conflict of interest shall be prevented in order to avoid harm to the lawful interests of citizens, organizations, society and the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 3. This part was repealed with effect from 20 February 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 27 January 2016 No. 5.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 3.1. Prevention or resolution of a conflict of interest may consist in changing the official or service position of the civil servant who is a party to it, up to suspension from official (service) duties in the prescribed manner, and/or relinquishment by that civil servant of the benefit that caused the conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 3.2. Failure by a civil servant who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 4. An employer’s representative who learns that a civil servant has a personal interest that gives rise or may give rise to a conflict of interest must take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest, up to suspending the civil servant who is a party to the conflict of interest from the civil service position held, in accordance with the procedure established by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 4.1. Failure by a civil servant acting as an employer's representative who has learned that a subordinate civil servant has a personal interest causing or potentially causing a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal of the civil servant acting as the employer's representative from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 5. To ensure compliance with requirements for civil servants’ official conduct and the resolution of conflicts of interest, conflict-of-interest resolution commissions shall be established in all state bodies.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 6. A conflict-of-interest commission is established by a legal act of a state body in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 7. Conflict-of-interest commissions are formed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could influence their decisions.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 8. This part was repealed with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.label: Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 1. In the cases established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, information on income, property and property-related obligations shall be submitted to the employer’s representative by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 2) a civil servant.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 2. The regulation on the submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations by a civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow shall be approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow, taking account of the requirements of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 3. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article is confidential unless classified as a state secret by federal law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 4. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article may not be used to establish or determine the solvency of the civil servant, their spouse or minor children, or to collect donations (contributions), directly or indirectly, for the funds of public or religious associations or other organizations, or for individuals.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 5. Persons responsible for disclosing information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article, or for using that information for purposes not provided for by federal laws, bear liability in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 6. The accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article are verified in accordance with the procedure established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 6.1. A civil servant’s failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations where its submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information on income, property and property-related obligations, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 6.2. A civil servant’s submission of knowingly inaccurate information on income, property and property-related obligations is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Part 6.2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 7. This part was repealed with effect from 30 March 2026 by Law of the City of Moscow of 25 March 2026 No. 4.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.label: Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 1. A civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by the relevant regulatory legal act of the City of Moscow must submit information on expenditure to the employer’s representative in the cases established by the Federal Law ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income’, in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 2. The correspondence of the expenditure of a civil servant, their spouse and their minor children to their income is monitored in accordance with the procedure established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, the Federal Law ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income’, regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 3. A civil servant’s failure to submit information on expenditure where its submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information on expenditure, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 4. A civil servant’s submission of knowingly inaccurate information on expenditure is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.text: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.label: Art. 16.2

units.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.text: telecommunications network ‘Internet’
units.label: Art. 16.2 · “telecommunications network ‘Internet’”

units.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.text: 1. Information on the addresses of websites and/or website pages on the Internet information and telecommunications network on which a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant has posted publicly accessible information, and data enabling their identification, is submitted to the employer's representative by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16.2

units.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position, upon entry into service, for the three calendar years preceding the year of entry into the civil service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 16.2

units.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.text: 2) a civil servant, annually for the calendar year preceding the year in which the information is submitted, except where publicly accessible information was posted in the performance of the civil servant's official duties.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 16.2

units.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.text: 2. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted by citizens seeking civil service positions upon entry into the civil service, and by civil servants no later than 1 April of the year following the reporting year. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted using the form established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.2

units.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
units.text: 3. By decision of the employer's representative, civil servants authorized by that representative process publicly accessible information posted on the Internet information and telecommunications network by applicants for civil service positions and civil servants, and verify the accuracy and completeness of the information provided for by part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16.2

units.locator: Chapter 4. Entry into the civil service
units.text: Chapter 4. Entry into the civil service
units.label: Chapter 4. Entry into the civil service

units.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: 1. Citizens of the Russian Federation who have reached the age of 18, are proficient in the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements established by civil service legislation are entitled to enter the civil service.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: 2. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: 3. A citizen may not be admitted to the civil service in the cases provided for by points 1-9, 11 and 12 of part 1 of Article 12 of this Law. Other restrictions connected with entry into the civil service are established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.label: Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 1. A citizen’s entry into the civil service to fill a civil service position, or a civil servant’s filling of another civil service position, is based on the results of a competition, unless otherwise established by this Article. A competition to fill a civil service position (hereinafter also referred to as a competition) consists of assessing the professional level of applicants for the position, checking their compliance with the other established qualification requirements for the position, and selecting, on the basis of that assessment and check, a citizen or civil servant from among the applicants for appointment to the civil service position.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 2. No competition is held:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 1) upon appointment to civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories filled for a fixed term of office; 2) this point was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24,;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 3) when concluding a fixed-term service contract;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 18
